Who We Are

OUR PURPOSE

Built on passion, driven by vision, guided by purpose.

What Drives Us

OUR MISSION

To deliver world-class photography and videography that captures the authentic beauty of every moment — making our clients relive their most precious memories for a lifetime.

  • Deliver exceptional quality in every frame
  • Build lasting relationships with our clients
  • Make professional photography accessible to all
  • Tell authentic visual stories with integrity
Where We're Headed

OUR VISION

To become Africa's most trusted and celebrated visual storytelling studio — recognised globally for cinematic excellence, creative innovation, and human-centred photography.

  • Be the #1 studio in East Africa by 2027
  • Expand to 10+ African cities
  • Train the next generation of visual artists
  • Win international photography awards
What We're Building

OUR GOALS

Clear, ambitious milestones that keep us innovating, growing, and delivering extraordinary work for every client we serve.

  • Complete 1,000+ client projects by 2026
  • Launch online photography masterclasses
  • Offer same-day photo delivery service
  • Build a community of 50K+ followers
  • Open a state-of-the-art studio in Eldoret

Our Story

We don't just shoot.
We create magic.

Alvery Photography is dedicated to capturing life’s most meaningful moments through our lenses. We are an Eldoret-based photography and videography studio covering weddings, graduations, anniversaries, choir productions, livestreams and everything in between. We take bookings across Kenya, the UK and Mainland Europe.

Our passionate team combines technical mastery with artistic instinct — every project gets our full heart.

How It Works

FROM HELLO TO FINAL FILES

Four simple steps, so you always know what happens next.

1

Book

Send us your date, location and the service you want through the form or on WhatsApp. We confirm availability within 24 hours.

2

Plan

We talk through your vision, the schedule and the shot list, so nothing important is missed on the day.

3

Shoot

We arrive early, set up and capture everything, from the planned moments to the unplanned ones.

4

Deliver

You get colour-graded photos and edited films in an online gallery, ready to download and share.

Good To Know

QUESTIONS WE GET OFTEN

Which days are you available?

We take bookings six days a week. We are unavailable on Saturdays.

Do you travel for events?

Yes. We are based in Eldoret and take bookings across Kenya, the UK and Mainland Europe. Terms and conditions apply for international bookings.

How much does a session cost?

Every booking is quoted to the occasion, hours and deliverables. Call, WhatsApp or send the form and we will give you a package price.

How do I receive my photos and videos?

Edited photos and video are delivered to a private online gallery you can view and download from.

Can you livestream or record my event?

Yes. Livestreaming services and solo and choir video production are part of what we offer.

Can I get a custom package?

Absolutely. Tell us what you need in the booking form and we will put together a quote that fits your event and your budget.
